description: Start a recomention report: the questions are asked of every engine on the plan several times each, with live web search. THIS SPENDS MONEY: funding "credits" uses one agency credit from the user's account (plan must be FULL); funding "byok" runs on the user's own provider keys from this server's environment (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, PERPLEXITY_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, XAI_API_KEY, DATAFORSEO_API_KEY as login:password for Google AI Overview) and needs an active Agent plan on the account. Any subset of keys works and engines without a key are reported as skipped, but one of OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini is required. A refusal names the plan limit it hit. Always ask the user before calling it. Reports take several minutes: poll recomention_report_status about once a minute.

brand.description: Defaults to the name in the domain

engines.description: A subset of the plan's engines

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse to make a retried start land on the same report

prompts.description: Questions to ask; the rest are written for you. None may name the product.

name: recomention_report_start
title: Start a report (spends a credit or your provider keys)
